Equipment Acceptance Report – North District Substation
日期：2026年3月14日 ｜ 项目编号：UW-2291
本次验收范围为110千伏开关设备的更新改造，包括二次系统。施工按照工程量清单第4.2.7项执行。承包方已完整移交全部试验报告。

The scope of this acceptance covers the renovation of the 110 kV switchgear, including the secondary systems. The works were carried out in accordance with item 4.2.7 of the bill of quantities. The Contractor has handed over all test reports in full.

设备在上述缺陷整改完成前有条件验收。复查定于第18周进行。在此之前，保留结算金额5%的质量保证金。停送电操作须由电网调度中心统一下令。

The equipment is granted conditional acceptance pending rectification of the above defects. A re-inspection is scheduled for week 18. Until then, retention money of 5% of the settlement amount will be withheld. De-energisation and re-energisation may only be ordered centrally by the network control centre.
